record.field: Phone Bridge: install the phone app
Set up the VoIP Bridge phone app (extension {{ object.number }})

div.p: You have a phone extension: . Install the VoIP Bridge app on your Android phone to make and take calls on it.
On your Android phone, open and tap Download the app.

ol.li: If Chrome warns the file might be harmful, tap Download anyway.
When it has downloaded, tap Open (or open voip-bridge.apk from your notifications or Downloads).
If Android says Chrome isn't allowed to install apps, tap Settings, turn on Allow from this source, then go back.
Tap Install. Some phones (Xiaomi, Redmi) run a security scan first: wait, then tap Install or Continue.

div.p: Once the app is installed, open this email on the same phone and tap:

a.style: background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;

div.p: The app opens and signs itself in as extension ; you don't need a password. The button works once, on one phone, for days. If it has expired or you are setting up another phone, ask for a new invite.

ol.li: Allow the microphone and notifications when the app asks.
So calls ring when the phone is locked: Settings → Apps → VoIP Bridge → allow full-screen notifications, and set Battery to Unrestricted.

div.p: Already had an older VoIP Bridge app? If installing says App not installed or that it conflicts with an existing package, uninstall the old one first (press and hold its icon, then Uninstall), then install again.
